content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering a new issue where my software is unable to connect to the [product_name] module from the PC. When I attempt to connect, I receive this error: "An unexpected error occurred. Your data may be inconsistent and subsequent errors may occur. java.lang.UnsatisfiedLinkError: <install-dir>/bin/librxtxSerial.so: wrong ELF class EFLCLASS32: possible cause: architecture word width mismatch." For reference, I'm working on a 64-bit system. A second issue occurs when I go to Tools/options/interface and try to set up my serial port for communication: "Error while loading panel data java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError: could not initialize class gnu.io.CommPortIdentifier" Thank you for your assistance so far!

I resolved the second issue using the following method (for Debian systems): Run: apt-get install librxtx-java Create a symbolic link at <install-directory>/bin/librxtxSerial.so pointing to /usr/lib/jni/librxtxSerial.so That fixed the problem! This workaround is only necessary for 64-bit operating systems, not for 32-bit ones. If you are using another 64-bit Linux distribution, the steps should be similar.
